title: Frontend & Backend Performance
description: Subtle perf killers — re-render storms, blocking I/O, N+1 patterns, oversized imports.

rules.message: Inline object/array literal as prop forces child re-render every parent render.
rules.remediation: Hoist to useMemo or module scope if the value is stable.

rules.message: Wildcard import pulls the entire module into the bundle, defeats tree-shaking.
Synchronous file I/O blocks the daemon event loop — fine on boot, bad in request handlers.
rules.remediation: If inside a route handler, use fs.promises.readFile instead.
Cache parsed result in memory; invalidate on file mtime.

rules.message: `await` inside a for-loop is sequential. If items are independent, this is N×latency.
rules.remediation: If independent: `await Promise.all(items.map(...))`. Order-dependent? leave it.

rules.message: filter + indexOf is O(n²). On large lists this stutters the UI.
rules.remediation: Use a Set: `const set = new Set(other); items.filter(i => set.has(i))`.
